[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (33.2→30.1) + 과매도 구간 진입 및 지속, 하락 방향성.

· 스윙 지지선 ($0.16) + 피벗 S1과 일치, 강력한 지지 가능성.

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (5일 저가 < 20일 저가) + 약세 패턴 지속.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.15배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 보통 수준.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 30.1 RSI 과매도 탈출 및 $0.18 저항 돌파 시 매수 진입 조건.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.17) vs SMA5 ($0.17)/SMA20 ($0.19)/SMA50 ($0.22): Above short-term SMA5 but below mid-to-long-term SMA20/SMA50, indicating a weak trend position.
· Below SMA100 ($0.21)/SMA200 ($0.21): Sustaining strong weak position in the mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (7.6%) + Current price range is historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.2→30.1) + Entered and remaining in oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0010→-0.0007) + Worsening maintained, signaling continued weak trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $0.17) + Bandwidth at 25.05% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) + Aligns with Pivot S1, indicating strong support potential.
· Swing resistance ($0.18) + Breakout could lead to short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low < 20-day low) + Continued weak pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.15x) + Moderate confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Buy entry condition upon RSI exiting oversold at 30.1 and breaking resistance at $0.18.
